requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/average.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/average_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func Average(xs []float64) (float64, error)`. Return the arithmetic mean of xs. An empty slice returns a non-nil error.
acceptance_criteria: func Average(xs []float64) (float64, error): Return the arithmetic mean of xs. An empty slice returns a non-nil error.
